questions.prompt: What do you do when you feel tired?

answers.basic: I step away from the computer and get some water. If I've been sitting for hours, a short walk usually helps more than another coffee. Even walking around the block gives my eyes a break and makes it easier to concentrate when I sit down again.

I get tired after a long day of debugging, especially if I have a badminton lesson to teach in the evening. By the time I get home, I'm ready to sleep. On those days, I can feel the difference when I'm packing up my racket bag and realise I've barely sat down all evening.

Some days, yes. It mainly happens when work and coaching fall on the same day, so I try to leave one or two evenings free each week. A quiet evening at home usually gives me enough energy to enjoy the next lesson instead of rushing through it.
